transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Occupational health sent me over. They said my weight is dangerously low for someone who runs presses and does fabrication all day. I honestly just thought I was getting leaner and being more disciplined.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
Yes. If the scale goes up even a little, I panic. It feels like I’m losing the control I’ve worked so hard for, and I’m scared I’ll end up heavy again.
When you look at your body, do you feel fat even though other people say you’re too thin?
Yeah. When I catch myself in the shop window or look in the bathroom mirror, all I see is my stomach and thighs. They look too big to me, and then I feel awful about myself for the rest of the day.
What is your current weight?
I don’t know the exact number offhand. Occupational health said it was dangerously low for the kind of physical work I do, but I thought I was just getting leaner and more disciplined.
Have you been deliberately eating less in order to lose weight or keep from gaining weight?

Yeah. Most days it’s just coffee before my early shift, maybe half a protein bar for lunch, and then a small bowl of vegetables after yoga. Eating more than that makes me feel like the whole day is getting out of control.
Have your menstrual periods stopped?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track of that.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
I… I’m not sure what you mean exactly. Are you asking if I do it on purpose?
Yes — do you ever make yourself vomit on purpose after eating?
I don’t know. I mean, I haven’t really thought about it that way.
Have you ever made yourself throw up on purpose after eating?
I’m honestly not sure. I haven’t really paid attention to whether it was on purpose like that.
After you eat, do you ever intentionally make yourself vomit?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself doing that intentionally after I eat.
Do you use laxatives to try to control your weight?
I’m not sure. What exactly do you mean by using them to control my weight?
Have you taken laxatives to try to keep from gaining weight?
I’m not sure. I don’t really know if that’s why I would take them.
Do you exercise specifically to burn calories or prevent weight gain?
I mean… if the scale goes up even a little, I panic. It feels like I’m losing control and I’m going to end up heavy again.
Do you exercise to keep from gaining weight?
Yes. If the scale goes up even a little, I panic. I feel like I have to do something or I’ll lose all the control I’ve worked for and end up heavy again.
Has a doctor told you that your weight is significantly below what is considered healthy for your height?

Yes. Occupational health sent me over because they said my weight is dangerously low for someone doing press and fabrication work all day. I honestly just thought I was getting leaner and being more disciplined.
